sources.entry: SpecterAI - German-law AI assistant for source-linked legal research, contract review, and drafting. #freemium

summary.name: SpecterAI
summary.one_liner: SpecterAI is an AI legal platform for German law that supports legal research, document and case analysis, and drafting for individuals, law firms and in-house teams.
use_cases: Researching German statutes and case law with linked sources
Reviewing rental contracts and termination deadlines
Analysing large case files and correspondence for risks
Drafting letters, statements or court submissions from facts
Structuring a legal question into review steps
Calculating legal deadlines and checking public holidays
summary.what_it_does: The page describes SpecterAI as an AI platform focused on German law that combines research, analysis and legal orientation in one interface. Cortex, its agent, breaks complex questions into review steps, searches case files and legal sources, and combines the results with citations. Specter Cite is described as an add-on that searches over 30 legal databases and supplies current statutory text with sources to Claude, ChatGPT or custom applications. The tool can also analyse uploaded contracts, spreadsheets and correspondence, flag contradictions and risks, and generate structured Word drafts for review. The page says it supports multiple languages and offers a free account.
notable: Cortex agent that plans review steps and cites sources
Specter Cite supplies verified German legal text to Claude and ChatGPT
Analyses uploaded contracts, spreadsheets and long correspondence
Zero Data Retention claimed with AI providers and no training on user content
caveats: Specter Cite is an add-on for business teams, and the page does not give its price
Team and expert plans have pricing that the page does not state; pricing details are on a separate page
The 86% reduction in false citations is a claim from the vendor's own benchmark
